rawContent: We know that antiblackness exists within other people of color groups, but don't let that stop you from caring about what happened last night in Atlanta. Humanity must be lifted up within yourselves and in others. None of us are free til all of us are free. #BLM #AsianLivesMatter

If anyone wants to support and uplift the fight against police sanctioned violence, send some money to the mothers of the victims. Give clout to NO ONE. #Openyourpurse #BLM #SamariaRice https://t.co/o7DqEXx2g7

Saying #StopAAPIHate #StopAsianHate addresses who this affects and puts them in the center of the discussion at this time for white ppl to address and dismantle #whitesupremacy. #BlackLivesMatter does the same. We are not free till all are
